evidence.span:
There’s a slam as our front door swings open, and I jump so abruptly my soul just about leaves my body. Eric’s gangly frame hangs slanted in the doorway, and his tanned brow is creased.


“Ara,” he says in a breath. “Can you come outside, please? Vikemy’s here.”

As we near the archway that opens out onto the Temple grounds, I notice Sal, my late friend Cosmer’s mother. She’s struggling to wheel her cart of freshly laundered and starched soldier’s uniforms. It’s going to flip.


Wasting no time, I bolt over and grasp the handles to pull her cart straight again.
